approaches_tried.approach: Fixture H asserting the guard stub's marker line literally appears (grep) in the census script's own captured stdout/stderr
approaches_tried.reason: The census script correctly never echoes its internal BUILD_OUTPUT capture verbatim -- only derived counts (compiler_sorry_count etc.) reach its own output. The marker line is trapped inside BUILD_OUTPUT and can never surface to a caller's captured output by design. Corrected Fixture H (from Phase 1) to prove the guarded path was taken indirectly: gave the guard stub a distinctive sorry-line count (3) different from both Fixture G's plain-lake stub (2) and the unused plain-lake stub also left on PATH in Fixture H (1), then asserted compiler_sorry_count reflects the guard stub's count. This also incidentally exercises the same substring-grep tolerance the real guard's memory-pressure warn line depends on, since the marker line does not match the sorry-declaration pattern.
